quarterly_data.signal: ASUS Republic of Gamers announced on October 6, 2026 that the ROG Rapture GT-BN98 quad-band WiFi 8 gaming router is now shipping: up to 25,000Mbps of bandwidth, new MCS rates, UEQM and NPCA, two 10G and four 2.5G wired ports.
